title: xphd: exciton-phonon post-processing for two-dimensional semiconductors
description: Exciton-phonon post-processing for two-dimensional semiconductors, from Quantum ESPRESSO, LetzElPhC and yambo databases: exciton-phonon matrix elements across the Brillouin zone, broadening-free exciton linewidths, mirror-parity and symmetry analysis, phonon-assisted optics and real-time exciton Boltzmann transport.
